source: OpenAI Codex subagents and hooks documentation: https://developers.openai.com/codex/subagents and https://developers.openai.com/codex/hooks; validated against codex-cli 0.147.0.

explicit_model.verified: Any model named in config.toml. Unset inherits from the parent, so it is always written.

reasoning_effort.verified: Documented per-agent key. Supported GPT models expose low, medium, high, xhigh, and max; the selected model determines which levels are accepted.

tool_allowlist.verified: No per-agent tool allowlist is documented; only mcp_servers scopes what an agent reaches. A tool grant therefore renders as an instruction plus an unenforced disclosure, never as a claim of isolation.

read_only_enforced.verified: sandbox_mode = "read-only" is enforced by the host sandbox. A parent session's live sandbox or approval policy can still override a custom agent default, so this is not an absolute project policy boundary.

scoped_hooks.verified: No per-agent hook mechanism is documented. Codex PreToolUse payloads do not document worker identity, so root-versus-worker write separation is instructional and review-based, not hook-enforced.
